entries.meaningZh: 毛鳞鱼（Mallotus villosus；不沿用原条“香鱼科”标签）
entries.en: We watched a shoal of capelin flash silver beneath the pier.
entries.zh: 我们看着一群毛鳞鱼在码头下闪着银光。

entries.meaningZh: 无党派倾向；不偏袒任何党派的原则或状态
entries.en: The debate moderator insisted on nonpartisanship and gave each candidate the same speaking time.
entries.zh: 辩论主持人坚持不偏袒任何党派，给了每位候选人同样的发言时间。

entries.meaningZh: 高尔夫球杆头上供杆身插入的颈管或插孔
entries.en: The club repairer inspected the hosel before fitting a new shaft.
entries.zh: 球杆维修师先检查了杆头的颈管，再装上新的杆身。

entries.meaningZh: 伽林（古代医师及医学著作家）
entries.en: The historian added a chapter on Galen to her book about ancient medicine.
entries.zh: 那位历史学家在自己的古代医学著作中增写了一章，介绍伽林。

entries.meaningZh: 复节奏的；多个声部同时采用不同节奏的
entries.en: The polyrhythmic passage gave the drummer and pianist different patterns to play at the same time.
entries.zh: 那段复节奏乐段让鼓手和钢琴家同时演奏不同的节奏型。

entries.meaningZh: 卑鄙可鄙的人（俚语贬称）
entries.en: In the comedy, she calls the man who stole the charity money a slimeball.
entries.zh: 在那部喜剧里，她把偷走慈善款的男人骂作卑鄙小人。

entries.meaningZh: 活泼轻快地；精神饱满地
entries.en: She waved perkily from the back of the bus, still smiling after the long walk.
entries.zh: 她从公交车后部活泼地挥着手，走了那么远仍然笑容满面。

entries.meaningZh: 啤酒店女主人（旧称）
entries.en: In the historical novel, the alewife keeps a room above the tavern for travellers.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说里，啤酒店女主人把酒馆楼上的一间房留给旅客住。

entries.meaningZh: 恩佐（法拉利跑车车型）
entries.en: He lifted the dust cover to reveal a red Enzo at the back of the garage.
entries.zh: 他掀起防尘罩，露出了车库后部一辆红色的恩佐跑车。

entries.meaningZh: 在原子尺度上；以原子为尺度地
entries.en: The model depicts an atomically thin layer stretched across a tiny opening.
entries.zh: 这个模型描绘了一层横跨微小开口、仅原子尺度厚的薄层。

entries.meaningZh: 超心理学的（研究所谓超常心理现象，不表示此类能力已获证实）
entries.en: The reviewer questioned the controls used in the parapsychological experiment.
entries.zh: 评审者质疑了那项超心理学实验所采用的对照措施。

entries.meaningZh: 毗瑟挐（印度教神祇）
entries.en: The gallery placed the sculpture of Vishnu beside a panel explaining its history.
entries.zh: 美术馆把毗瑟挐雕像放在一块介绍其历史的说明牌旁。

entries.meaningZh: 精工（手表品牌；本例不采用打印机厂商标签）
entries.en: He put his Seiko watch in its box before leaving for the swimming pool.
entries.zh: 去游泳池前，他把自己的精工手表放进了表盒。

entries.meaningZh: 轻轻击出越过棒球内野的高飞短球
entries.en: She managed to bloop the ball just over the shortstop's glove.
entries.zh: 她设法把球轻轻挑起，刚好越过游击手的手套。

entries.meaningZh: 极其；非常（强调程度）
entries.en: The missing zero made the error screamingly obvious to everyone at the table.
entries.zh: 漏掉的那个零让桌边所有人一眼就能看出这个错误。

entries.meaningZh: 粪便（源自法语的粗俗借词）
entries.en: After stepping in merde on the path, he left his shoes outside the door.
entries.zh: 他在小路上踩到粪便后，把鞋留在了门外。

entries.meaningZh: 人体冷冻保存的（以未来复苏为设想，不表示已能实现）
entries.en: The journalist questioned the promises made in the cryonic preservation brochure.
entries.zh: 那位记者质疑了人体冷冻保存宣传册中的承诺。

entries.meaningZh: 菲利斯（人名；本例不限定性别或声称与Felicia完全等同）
entries.en: Felice left a handwritten note beside the unfinished jigsaw puzzle.
entries.zh: 菲利斯在还没拼完的拼图旁留了一张手写便条。

entries.meaningZh: 浮夸地；夸大地
entries.en: From behind a borrowed desk, he grandiosely announced the opening of his 'international headquarters'.
entries.zh: 他在借来的办公桌后，浮夸地宣布自己的“国际总部”开张了。

entries.meaningZh: 迷信地；出于迷信地
entries.en: She superstitiously touched the same stone before every performance.
entries.zh: 每次演出前，她都会出于迷信摸一摸同一块石头。

entries.meaningZh: 斑驳不均的状态；分布不均匀
entries.en: The patchiness of the lawn was especially visible after the snow melted.
entries.zh: 积雪融化后，草坪斑驳不均的样子格外明显。

entries.meaningZh: 通过动觉；凭对身体运动的感觉
entries.en: With her eyes closed, she kinesthetically tracked the movement of her raised arm.
entries.zh: 她闭着眼睛，凭动觉感知抬起的手臂的运动。

entries.meaningZh: 靠政治任命获公职的人（主要英式，常含贬意）
entries.en: In the historical drama, the pamphlet dismisses the new official as a placeman.
entries.zh: 在那部历史剧里，小册子贬称新官员是个靠政治任命上位的人。

entries.meaningZh: 组织病理学的；与病变组织的研究有关的
entries.en: The textbook places a histopathological image beside the diagram of healthy tissue.
entries.zh: 教材把一幅组织病理学图像放在健康组织示意图旁边。

entries.meaningZh: 奥克尼群岛的
entries.en: The collection includes an Orcadian folktale about a mysterious visitor.
entries.zh: 这本文集收录了一个关于神秘访客的奥克尼群岛民间故事。

entries.meaningZh: 难事；苦差事（粗俗口语）
entries.en: 'Moving that sofa was a real pisser,' he said, rubbing his sore arms.
entries.zh: “搬那张沙发可真是件苦差事，”他一边揉着酸痛的胳膊一边说。

entries.meaningZh: 嘉兰属植物（Gloriosa；本例不采用伞绸释义）
entries.en: The gardener tied the gloriosa loosely to a thin support.
entries.zh: 园丁把那株嘉兰属植物松松地绑在一根细支架上。

entries.meaningZh: 矫揉造作地；过分讲究地（贬义）
entries.en: He spoke preciously about the 'exquisite soul' of his ordinary teacup.
entries.zh: 他矫揉造作地谈论着自己那只普通茶杯的“精致灵魂”。

entries.meaningZh: 笨拙或经验不足的拳击手（俚语贬称）
entries.en: In the boxing comedy, the veteran calls his awkward new opponent a palooka.
entries.zh: 在那部拳击喜剧里，老拳手把笨拙的新对手贬称为蹩脚拳手。

entries.meaningZh: 潮虫；鼠妇（陆生等足类甲壳动物，复数）
entries.en: Several woodlice hurried under the flowerpot when I lifted it.
entries.zh: 我抬起花盆时，几只潮虫匆匆钻到了花盆下面。

entries.meaningZh: 马桶；厕所（粗俗俚语）
entries.en: 'The shitter is blocked again,' he muttered, hanging an out-of-order sign on the door.
entries.zh: “马桶又堵了，”他嘟囔着，把一块停用告示挂在门上。

entries.meaningZh: 铁线蕨属植物（maidenhair fern的较少见形式）
entries.en: A maidenhair spread its delicate fronds over the rim of the terracotta pot.
entries.zh: 一株铁线蕨的纤细叶片伸展到了陶盆边沿外。

entries.meaningZh: 竹类密丛（本例为野生竹，不泛译作藤丛）
entries.en: The path ended at a canebrake of wild bamboo, so we turned back.
entries.zh: 小路尽头是一片野生竹密丛，于是我们原路返回。

entries.meaningZh: 色迷迷盯着别人看的人
entries.en: She moved to another seat to escape the ogler who kept staring at her.
entries.zh: 为了避开那个一直色迷迷盯着她看的人，她换了一个座位。

entries.meaningZh: 更酥脆的（crispy的比较级）
entries.en: The biscuits on the edge of the tray were crispier than the ones in the middle.
entries.zh: 烤盘边缘的饼干比中间的更酥脆。

entries.meaningZh: 雀鲷（雀鲷科鱼类，不泛指所有小型热带鱼）
entries.en: A damselfish hovered beside the coral while the diver sketched it.
entries.zh: 潜水员画速写时，一条雀鲷悬游在珊瑚旁。

entries.meaningZh: 性腺的；与性腺有关的（非疾病名称）
entries.en: The diagram marks the gonadal tissue in a different colour.
entries.zh: 这张示意图用另一种颜色标出性腺组织。

entries.meaningZh: 跑得比……快；在奔跑中超过（outrun的过去式）
entries.en: Mira outran the other runners and reached the hilltop first.
entries.zh: 米拉跑得比其他选手快，第一个到达山顶。

entries.meaningZh: 康复救护人员（本例为野生动物救护）
entries.en: The wildlife rehabilitator watched the owl make its first short flight across the enclosure.
entries.zh: 野生动物救护员看着那只猫头鹰第一次在围护区内作短距离飞行。

entries.meaningZh: 银香菊（本例明确为Santolina chamaecyparissus）
entries.en: The santolina labelled Santolina chamaecyparissus was the last plant left on the nursery bench.
entries.zh: 育苗台上最后剩下的植物，是那株标签写着学名Santolina chamaecyparissus的银香菊。

entries.meaningZh: 无来源的（本例为虚构场景中无发光源的光辉）
entries.en: In the fantasy novel, a sourceless glow filled the sealed stone chamber.
entries.zh: 在那部奇幻小说里，一道无源的光辉充满了密封的石室。

entries.meaningZh: 按等级或层级组织的；等级制的
entries.en: The firm replaced its hierarchal structure with small self-managed teams.
entries.zh: 这家公司用小型自主管理团队取代了原来的等级制结构。

entries.meaningZh: 慌乱；焦躁忙乱（非正式用语）
entries.en: He was in a tizzy after discovering that the birthday cake had gone to the wrong address.
entries.zh: 发现生日蛋糕被送错地址后，他慌得团团转。

entries.meaningZh: 斯基弗尔乐（常以简易或非标准乐器伴奏的民间爵士乐风格及其英国衍生形式）
entries.en: Their skiffle band rehearsed in the shed, with a washboard providing the rhythm.
entries.zh: 他们的斯基弗尔乐队在棚屋里排练，用洗衣板打着节奏。
